comments.text: A country where people comfortably strip down in saunas or on summer rocks without any judgment or sexualization. Swedish women are fiercely independent—they split bills and don't wait for anyone to arrange their lives. Interestingly, Swedes love silence and personal space, yet they completely open up during "Fika" (coffee and cinnamon buns). Would you dare to plunge into a frozen lake after a sauna like them? 🧖‍♀🧊
